headline: Accesscode Talker
title: Accesscode Talker Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Accesscode Talker. What is it? It is a DARK Cyberse Link Monster with two thousand three hundred base attack. What does it do? When Link Summoned it gains attack equal to one Link Monster used as material, times one thousand. Your opponent cannot respond to its effects, and it can banish Link Monsters to destroy their cards. How do you use it? Use a big Link Monster as material for a huge attack boost, then banish Link Monsters to destroy cards. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!
